svg.text: Not obvious; requiring attention to notice.
There is a subtle difference in tone between
Use subtle for a difference or effect that is hard
to notice, not one that is unimportant. Subtly is
the adverb: Her tone changed subtly.
A: Do those replies sound the same to you?
B: There is a subtle difference in tone.
B: The second sounds slightly warmer, though
